raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Overview Use TMA for MOE up/down proj ## Test Tested on H200 ### Acc covered in unit test ### Perf ```bash vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3 \ --trust-remote-code \ -tp 8 \ --load-format fastsafetensors \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 \ --enable-prefix-caching \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 9256 \ --max-model-len auto \ --max-num-seqs 48 \ --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}' guidellm run \ --backend '{"kind":"openai_http","target":"http://127.0.0.1:9256","model":"zai-org/GLM-5.3","request_format":"/v1/chat/completions","timeout":100000,"extras":{"body":{"temperature":1.0,"top_p":0.95}}}' \ --tokenizer '{"kind":"huggingface_auto","model":"zai-org/GLM-5.3","load_kwargs":{"trust_remote_code":true}}' \ --data 'kind=synthetic_text,prompt_tokens=8000,output_tokens=1000' \ --profile 'kind=concurrent,warmup=0.1,cooldown=0.1' \ --override profile.streams '1,4,16' \ --constraint 'kind=max_duration,seconds=150' \ --constraint 'kind=max_errors,count=10' \ --seed 'kind=static,value=42' \ --metrics 'kind=generative,sample_size=20' \ --output 'kind=json,path=/home/yewentao256/guidellm-results/output_vllm_glm53_8k1k_1024.json' ``` And we can get Concurrency | P50 Latency（Base） | Current P50 Latency | P50 Throughput（Base） | Current P50 Throughput | P50 TTFT（Base） | Current P50 TTFT -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- 4 | 10.93 s | 10.90 s（−0.3%） | 297.7 tok/s | 307.8 tok/s（+3.4%）🚀 | 673.8 ms | 642.3 ms（−4.7%）🚀 16 | 24.75 s | 24.29 s（−1.9%） | 497.3 tok/s | 512.9 tok/s（+3.1%）🚀 | 698.9 ms | 685.5 ms（−1.9%） Somehow lost the concurrency 1, I don't have cards to test again now, would appreciate a validation. But it should have the similar result from microbenchmark. M | main | now | perf -- | -- | -- | -- 24 | 78.366 μs | 62.771 μs | 19.90% 96 | 125.521 μs | 101.571 μs | 19.08% 1024 | 223.305 μs | 189.129 μs | 15.30% [baseline.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33982121/baseline.json) [tma.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33982122/tma.json) --- Need help on this PR? +@pytest.mark.parametrize("M", [24, 1024])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("modular", [False, True])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_h200_block_fp8_up_and_down_tma_matches_pointer(M, modular, workspace_init):
+    if "H200" not in torch.cuda.get_device_name():
+        pytest.skip("This block FP8 TMA test targets H200")
+
+    E, N, K, topk = 256, 256, 128, 8
+    torch.manual_seed(123)
+    a = torch.randn((M, K), dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 10
+    score = torch.randn((M, E), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    w1, w2, quant_config = make_test_quant_config(
+        E, N, K, torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn, block_shape=[128, 128]
+    )
+    topk_weights, topk_ids, _ = fused_topk(a, score.float(), topk, False)
+
+    config_args = (w1.shape, w2.shape, topk, "fp8_w8a8", M)
+    config = try_get_optimal_moe_config(*config_args, block_shape=[128, 128])
+    assert w2.is_contiguous()
+
+    if modular:
+        moe = modular_triton_fused_moe(make_dummy_moe_config(), quant_config)
+
+        def run():
+            return moe.apply(
+                a,
+                w1,
+                w2,
+                topk_weights,
+                topk_ids,
+                activation=MoEActivation.SILU,
+                apply_router_weight_on_input=False,
+                expert_map=None,
+                global_num_experts=E,
+            )
+
+    else:
+
+        def run():
+            return fused_experts(
+                a, w1, w2, topk_weights, topk_ids, quant_config=quant_config
+            )
+
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        with override_config({**config, "USE_TMA": False}):
+            pointer_output = run()
+        tma_output = run()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(tma_output, pointer_output, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
